  [2/4] Step 2 of 4 – Set up Relay Auth Token

  NOVA keeps client and Home Assistant access separate:
    a) This Relay token protects the connection from this computer
    b) The Home Assistant App receives its upstream access automatically

  Standalone Container/Core relays keep HA_LLAT in the server environment; the CLI never asks for it.

  Choose how to set up the Relay Auth Token:

    1) Paste existing token from another device / Home Assistant
    2) Generate a new token

  Enter [1-2] (default 2, or type 'back'/'exit'): 
  Here is your relay token (generated automatically):
    <token>

  Next, on the NOVA App page:
    1. Open the "Configuration" tab
    2. Paste the token into the "Relay Auth Token" field ("relay_auth_token")
    3. Click Save
    4. Restart the App so it picks up the new token
